sentences.en: He sometimes drove to affluent neighbourhoods and parked outside of houses he liked to picture himself living in.

sentences.en: He was the type who tried to break others down just so he could build them back up and then control them.
sentences.zh: 他属于那种试图摧毁别人，以便自己能重新塑造并控制他们的人。

sentences.en: Larry was the manipulator while Emil was more the follower.
sentences.zh: 拉里是操纵者，而埃米尔更多是追随者。

sentences.en: He did whatever Larry wanted.
sentences.zh: 他唯拉里马首是瞻。

sentences.en: On July 20 1993, the pair successfully committed their first robbery, ambushing an armoured car outside a branch of First Bank in Littleton, Colorado.
sentences.zh: 1993年7月20日，两人成功实施了第一次抢劫，在科罗拉多州利特尔顿的第一银行分行外伏击了一辆运钞车。

sentences.en: The police were unable to identify any suspects and the pair got away with it.
sentences.zh: 警方无法确定任何嫌疑人，两人侥幸逃脱。

sentences.en: Three months later, on October 29 1993,
sentences.zh: 三个月后，1993年10月29日，

sentences.en: 93, Larry and Emil were driving through Glendale, California when they were pulled over by Sergeant
sentences.zh: 拉里和埃米尔开车经过加利福尼亚州格伦代尔时，被伊恩·格莱姆斯警长拦下。

sentences.en: Ian Grimes.
sentences.zh: 拉里开车，埃米尔坐在前排副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Larry was driving and Emil was in the front passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 当被问及身份时，

sentences.en: When questioned,
sentences.zh: 拉里说他把驾照忘在家里了，并报了一个假名。

sentences.en: Larry said he had left his license at home and he gave a false name.
sentences.zh: 格莱姆斯警长随后询问这辆车是谁的，埃米尔回答说是拉里母亲的车。

sentences.en: Sergeant Grimes then asked whose car it was, to which Emil replied it was Larry's mother's car.
sentences.zh: 格莱姆斯警长已经查过记录，他知道这辆车实际上是机场租来的。

sentences.en: Sergeant Grimes had already done a check and he knew the car was actually an airport rental.
sentences.zh: 他要求拉里下车并对他进行搜身，发现了一把配有33发加长弹匣的格洛克手枪。

sentences.en: He asked Larry to step out of the vehicle and then patted him down, finding a Glock pistol with an extended 33-round magazine.
sentences.zh: 车内随即传来一声沉闷的撞击声。

sentences.en: A loud thud then came from inside the car.
sentences.zh: 那是埃米尔将自己的手枪扔到副驾驶座位下的声音。

sentences.en: It was the sound of Emil dropping his own pistol underneath the passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 格莱姆斯警长呼叫支援，并控制住拉里和

sentences.en: Sergeant Grimes called for assistance and covered Larry and
sentences.zh: 埃米尔，直到增援部队赶到。

sentences.en: Emil until backup arrived.
sentences.zh: 随后的搜车行动中，警方发现了一支半自动步枪和一把属于拉里的斯普林菲尔德手枪，以及一支半自动步枪和一把属于埃米尔的柯尔特手枪。

sentences.en: A subsequent search of the car uncovered a semi-automatic rifle and a Springfield pistol belonging to Larry, as well as a semi-automatic rifle and a Colt pistol belonging to Emil.
sentences.zh: 警方还发现了1649发39毫米弹药，967发9毫米弹药，

sentences.en: Police also found 1,649 rounds of 39mm ammo, 967 rounds of 9mm ammo,
sentences.zh: 以及357发.45口径弹药。

sentences.en: 357 rounds of .45 ammo
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号至149，已全部翻译）

sentences.en: 6 smoke bombs
sentences.zh: 6枚烟雾弹

sentences.en: 2 improvised explosive devices
sentences.zh: 2个简易爆炸装置

sentences.en: 1 gas mask
sentences.zh: 1个防毒面具

sentences.en: 2 sets of body armour
sentences.zh: 2套防弹衣

sentences.en: 2 police scanners sunglasses, gloves, wigs, ski masks and a stopwatch
sentences.zh: 2个警用扫描仪、太阳镜、手套、假发、滑雪面罩和一块秒表

sentences.en: 2 spray cans of hair colour
sentences.zh: 2罐喷雾染发剂

sentences.en: 3 different sets of Californian licence plates and $1,620 in cash
sentences.zh: 3副不同的加州车牌和1620美元现金

sentences.en: The police were convinced they had just stopped a bank robbery from happening.
sentences.zh: 警方确信他们刚刚阻止了一起银行抢劫案的发生。

sentences.en: And given what was to come, they were quite obviously right.
sentences.zh: 鉴于后来发生的事情，他们显然是对的。

sentences.en: Larry Phillips Jr.
sentences.zh: 拉里·菲利普斯（Larry Phillips Jr.）

sentences.en: and Emil Matasaranu were taken to the Glendale Police Station where they were both charged with conspiracy to commit robbery and unlawful weapons activity.
sentences.zh: 和埃米尔·马塔萨拉努（Emil Matasaranu）被带到格伦代尔警察局，两人均被控共谋抢劫和非法持有武器。

sentences.en: Larry was also charged with grand theft auto, carrying a loaded concealed firearm and felony perjury, while Emil was charged with carrying a loaded firearm in a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 拉里还被控盗窃机动车、携带上膛隐蔽枪支和重罪伪证罪，而埃米尔则被控在车内携带上膛枪支。

sentences.en: At their preliminary hearing, the grand theft auto and the perjury charges against Larry were dropped, but the two men still faced eight years jail on the remaining charges.
sentences.zh: 在预审听证会上，针对拉里的盗窃机动车和伪证指控被撤销，但两人仍因剩余指控面临八年监禁。

sentences.en: The problem was, neither Larry nor Emil said a word, and the police had no other information to go on.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，拉里和埃米尔一言不发，警方也没有其他线索可循。

sentences.en: Despite the arsenal and disguises they were found with, it was difficult to prove they were going to commit a robbery.
sentences.zh: 尽管搜出了武器库和伪装用品，但很难证明他们打算实施抢劫。

sentences.en: At their arraignment, Larry and Emile claimed the disguises were for an upcoming Halloween party.
sentences.zh: 在传讯时，拉里和埃米尔声称这些伪装是为了即将到来的万圣节派对准备的。

sentences.en: As for the weapons and ammo, they said they were headed to a shooting range.
sentences.zh: 至于武器和弹药，他们说正打算去射击场。

sentences.en: In exchange for early guilty pleas, the district attorney dropped the conspiracy to commit robbery charges and allowed Larry and Emile to plead to much lesser offences.
sentences.zh: 为了换取提前认罪，地方检察官撤销了共谋抢劫罪的指控，允许拉里和埃米尔承认较轻的罪名。

sentences.en: On December 27, 1993, Larry was sentenced to 99 days in jail, while Emil was sentenced to 71 days, and both were given three years probation.
sentences.zh: 1993年12月27日，拉里被判入狱99天，埃米尔被判入狱71天，两人均被判处三年缓刑。

sentences.en: Both men were released immediately due to time already served.
sentences.zh: 由于已服刑期，两人均被立即释放。

sentences.en: Larry was still wanted in Denver on the rental property scam, but for unknown reasons, Denver authorities didn't pursue him.
sentences.zh: 拉里在丹佛仍因租赁诈骗案被通缉，但出于未知原因，丹佛当局并未追捕他。

sentences.en: Without being extradited back to Colorado to face punishment, he was essentially a free man.
sentences.zh: 在没有被引渡回科罗拉多州接受惩罚的情况下，他实际上是个自由人。

sentences.en: Just under a year and a half after Larry Phillips Jr.
sentences.zh: 在拉里·菲利普斯和

sentences.en: and Emil Matasaranu were released, on June 14, 1995, a 52-year-old security guard named Herman Cook was doing his rounds as an
sentences.zh: 埃米尔·马塔萨拉努获释不到一年半后，1995年6月14日，一名52岁的保安赫尔曼·库克（Herman Cook）正在执行他的巡逻任务，他是

sentences.en: armoured car guard for a cash handling company called Brinks.
sentences.zh: 一家名为布林克斯（Brinks）的现金处理公司的运钞车保安。

sentences.en: It was Herman's job to drop off and pick up cash for various banks.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼的工作是为各家银行运送和提取现金。

sentences.en: At around 12.25pm he had just made a drop-off at the Bank of America branch on Roscoe Boulevard in the quiet Los Angeles neighbourhood of Winnetka.
sentences.zh: 下午12点25分左右，他刚在洛杉矶温内特卡（Winnetka）安静社区的美国银行分行完成了一次送款。

sentences.en: Herman was walking back to the armoured car with an empty money bag when gunshots suddenly rang out.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼提着一个空钱袋走回运钞车时，突然响起了枪声。

sentences.en: Larry Phillips Jr and Emil Matasaranu were firing high-powered rifles from behind a wall in an adjacent parking lot.
sentences.zh: 拉里·菲利普斯和埃米尔·马塔萨拉努正躲在相邻停车场的墙后，用大威力步枪射击。

sentences.en: Herman was shot multiple times.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼身中数弹。

sentences.en: He staggered to the front of the car and collapsed.
sentences.zh: 他踉跄着走到车前，倒了下去。

sentences.en: Herman's partner Felipe Cortez was in the armoured car at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时，赫尔曼的搭档费利佩·科尔特斯（Felipe Cortez）正在运钞车内。

sentences.en: Emil opened fire on the vehicle while Larry made the approach.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔向车辆开火，而拉里则逼近车辆。

sentences.en: Felipe managed to take out his own firearm and shoot one of the offenders, but they only staggered, indicating they were wearing body armour.
sentences.zh: 费利佩设法掏出自己的枪并击中了其中一名罪犯，但对方只是踉跄了一下，这表明他们穿着防弹衣。

sentences.en: Larry reached into the car and grabbed a bag of money.
sentences.zh: 拉里伸手进车里抓走了一袋钱。

sentences.en: The two men then escaped, making off with around $122,000.
sentences.zh: 随后两人逃离现场，抢走了约12.2万美元。

sentences.en: Felipe was shot in the attack but survived.
sentences.zh: 费利佩在袭击中中弹，但幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Herman wasn't so lucky.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼就没有那么幸运了。

sentences.en: He died from the gunshot wounds.
sentences.zh: 他因枪伤身亡。

sentences.en: After that, Larry and Emil decided to change tactics.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，拉里和埃米尔决定改变战术。

sentences.en: Ten and a half months later, at 10am on May 2, 1996, they burst through the doors of the Bank of America branch on Woodman Avenue in the Los Angeles neighbourhood of Van Nuys.
sentences.zh: 十个半月后，1996年5月2日上午10点，他们冲进了位于洛杉矶范奈斯（Van Nuys）社区伍德曼大道（Woodman Avenue）的美国银行分行。

sentences.en: Both armed with automatic rifles, they yelled at everyone in the bank to get on the fucking floor.
sentences.zh: 两人都手持自动步枪，大声喝令银行里的所有人“他妈的趴下”。

sentences.en: Emil then started shooting through the armoured Teller door.
sentences.zh: 随后，埃米尔开始向防弹柜员门开火。

sentences.en: Due to the type of weapon and calibre of bullet, the door opened easily.
sentences.zh: 由于武器类型和子弹口径的原因，门很容易就被打开了。

sentences.en: Emil forced the manager to open the vault and then started filling up a large bag with cash.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔强迫经理打开金库，然后开始往一个大袋子里装现金。

sentences.en: Larry remained in the main area of the bank, keeping an eye on the customers and other staff members.
sentences.zh: 拉里留在银行大厅，监视着顾客和其他员工。

sentences.en: In just six minutes, they managed to get away with $755,000.
sentences.zh: 仅仅六分钟，他们就抢走了75.5万美元。

sentences.en: 29 days later, at 10am on May 31, 1996, Larry and Emil burst through the doors of the Bank of America on Roscoe Boulevard in Winnetka.
sentences.zh: 29天后，1996年5月31日上午10点，拉里和埃米尔冲进了位于温内特卡罗斯科大道（Roscoe Boulevard）的美国银行。

sentences.en: It was the same branch they had targeted almost a year earlier when killing Brinks security guard Herman Cook.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们近一年前杀害布林克斯保安赫尔曼·库克时盯上的那家分行。

sentences.en: Again, the two men yelled at everybody to get down.
sentences.zh: 两人再次大声喝令所有人趴下。

sentences.en: Emile shot his way through the teller door, striking two bank employees with ricochets in the process.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔开枪打穿了柜员门，过程中流弹击伤了两名银行员工。

sentences.en: Emile grabbed the manager, forced her to open the vault and screamed at her to fill up his bag.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔抓住经理，强迫她打开金库，并尖叫着让她装满袋子。

sentences.en: When he saw how much money was in the vault, he became agitated.
sentences.zh: 当他看到金库里的钱数时，变得焦躁不安。

sentences.en: Where's the rest of it?
sentences.zh: “剩下的钱在哪？”

sentences.en: he screamed before threatening to kill the manager.
sentences.zh: 他尖叫着，并威胁要杀了经理。

sentences.en: Emil was expecting a much larger amount
sentences.zh: 埃米尔原本期待着更多的钱。

sentences.en: He and Larry had done surveillance on the bank and saw what they thought to be a cash delivery from an armoured car But what they had actually seen was a cash pick-up
sentences.zh: 他和拉里曾对这家银行进行过监视，看到了他们以为是运钞车送来的现金，但实际上他们看到的是现金提取。

sentences.en: Despite being disappointed in the hall they still managed to escape with over $794,000 though there were several marked bills amongst it
sentences.zh: 尽管对抢到的金额感到失望，他们还是设法带着超过79.4万美元逃脱了，尽管其中混杂着几张标记过的钞票。

sentences.en: The two employees who were struck by ricochets survived
sentences.zh: 那两名被流弹击中的员工幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Emil and Larry got lucky that day
sentences.zh: 埃米尔和拉里那天运气不错。

sentences.en: One of the tellers had managed to hit the silent alarm before diving onto the floor
sentences.zh: 其中一名柜员在趴下之前设法按下了静音警报。

sentences.en: But the police were thin on the ground and it took them much longer than usual to respond to the alarm
sentences.zh: 但当时警力不足，他们响应警报的时间比平时长得多。

sentences.en: Larry and Emil had been in the bank for close to 8 minutes
sentences.zh: 拉里和埃米尔在银行里待了近8分钟。

sentences.en: On a typical day, the police would have been able to respond within this time frame and it was likely they would have been caught.
sentences.zh: 在平时，警方本应能在此时间内做出响应，他们很可能会被抓获。

sentences.en: The police had no suspects for the robberies at the time, but they did give the unknown criminals a title, the High Incident Bandits.
sentences.zh: 当时警方对这些抢劫案没有任何嫌疑人，但他们给这些身份不明的罪犯起了一个代号：高危事件劫匪（High Incident Bandits）。

sentences.en: It would be nine months before they struck again.
sentences.zh: 距离他们再次作案还有九个月的时间。

sentences.en: Branch 384 of the Bank of America is located at 6600 Laurel Canyon Boulevard in North Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 美国银行第384分行位于北好莱坞劳雷尔峡谷大道（Laurel Canyon Boulevard）6600号。

sentences.en: Larry and Emil had studied the bank closely.
sentences.zh: 拉里和埃米尔仔细研究了这家银行。

sentences.en: They learned its layout, observed armour car drop-offs and pick-ups, and carefully formulated a plan.
sentences.zh: 他们了解了银行的布局，观察了运钞车的送款和取款情况，并精心制定了计划。

sentences.en: At around 9.15 on the morning of Friday, February 28, 1997,
sentences.zh: 1997年2月28日，星期五，上午9点15分左右，

sentences.en: Emil drove a white 1987 Chevrolet Celebrity sedan with blackened-out windows into the northern parking lot of the bank via Archwood Street.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔驾驶一辆车窗贴黑膜的白色1987年雪佛兰Celebrity轿车，经由阿奇伍德街（Archwood Street）进入银行北侧停车场。

sentences.en: The pair weren't mucking around.
sentences.zh: 两人可不是在闹着玩。

sentences.en: To protect himself, Larry wore a Kevlar body armour vest, a groin protector, and makeshift armour for his shins, thighs, and forearms that he'd crafted out of additional vests.
sentences.zh: 为了保护自己，拉里穿了一件凯夫拉防弹背心、一个护裆，以及他用额外的背心自制的护胫、护大腿和护前臂的简易护甲。

sentences.en: All up, the body armour weighed around 43 pounds, or 20 kilos.
sentences.zh: 总计下来，防弹衣重约43磅，即20公斤。

sentences.en: Larry also wore a load-bearing vest that contained ammunition pouches as well as a belt that contained several canteen pouches filled with ammunition drums for the automatic rifles
sentences.zh: 拉里还穿了一件带有弹药袋的战术背心，以及一条腰带，上面装有几个装满自动步枪弹鼓的军用水壶袋。

sentences.en: He also carried a pistol in a shoulder holster
sentences.zh: 他还肩挂了一把手枪。

sentences.en: Over his armour, Larry was dressed in long black pants a long-sleeved shirt and black jacket He wore black gloves with a watch face glued to the back of the left one
sentences.zh: 在护甲外面，拉里穿着长黑裤、长袖衬衫和黑色夹克。他戴着黑色手套，左手手套背面粘着一个手表表盘。

sentences.en: Emile was similarly dressed, right down to the glued-on watch face on the back of his glove
sentences.zh: 埃米尔的装束也差不多，连手套背面粘着手表表盘这一点都一样。

sentences.en: However, he wasn't wearing quite as much body armour as Larry, with his legs and arms unprotected
sentences.zh: 不过，他穿的防弹衣没有拉里那么多，腿部和手臂都没有保护。

sentences.en: Given their shared interest in bodybuilding, both men were largely built
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们对健美的共同爱好，两人的体格都很魁梧。

sentences.en: As if they didn't already look intimidating enough, they topped things off by wearing black ski masks
sentences.zh: 为了让自己看起来更具威慑力，他们还戴上了黑色滑雪面罩。

sentences.en: Between the pair, they had three AK-47 style fully automatic assault rifles with 100 round
sentences.zh: 两人总共拥有三支AK-47式全自动突击步枪，配有100发

sentences.en: ammo drums, as well as two other assault rifles which had been illegally modified to fire fully automatic.
sentences.zh: 弹鼓，以及另外两支被非法改装成全自动射击的突击步枪。

sentences.en: Two 9mm handguns, a .38 calibre revolver, close to 3,000 rounds of ammo, including armour-piercing rounds.
sentences.zh: 两把9毫米手枪，一把.38口径左轮手枪，近3000发弹药，包括穿甲弹。

sentences.en: These were weapons that were designed for war.
sentences.zh: 这些都是为战争设计的武器。

sentences.en: By listening to police radios, Larry and Emil had learned that the average response time for police was 8 minutes.
sentences.zh: 通过监听警用无线电，拉里和埃米尔得知警方的平均响应时间为8分钟。

sentences.en: At 9.17am, they set their watches for 8 minutes and made their move.
sentences.zh: 上午9点17分，他们将手表定为8分钟，然后采取了行动。

sentences.zh: 《案件档案》（Casefile）稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 银行北门距离他们停车的地方大约32英尺。

sentences.en: They each grabbed an AK-47 and a handgun, leaving the other assault rifles in the Chevrolet, along with a police radio, and ran for the door.
sentences.zh: 他们每人抓起一支AK-47和一把手枪，将其他突击步枪和警用无线电留在雪佛兰车里，然后跑向门口。

sentences.en: At that very moment, a Los Angeles Police Department patrol vehicle occupied by officers
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，一辆载有警官的洛杉矶警察局巡逻车

sentences.en: Lauren Farrell and Martin Perrello was driving down Laurel Canyon Boulevard on a routine patrol.
sentences.zh: 劳伦·法雷尔（Lauren Farrell）和马丁·佩雷洛（Martin Perrello）正沿着劳雷尔峡谷大道进行例行巡逻。

sentences.en: By pure luck, the officers were in the right place at the right time, or the wrong place at the wrong time, depending on which way you look at it.

sentences.en: The pair spotted a dentist surgery nearby and made a run for it while Larry continued peppering them with bullets.

sentences.en: When they got to the dentist's door, they didn't have time to stop and open it.

sentences.en: Instead, they just dove right through the glass.

sentences.en: Larry turned his attention to them and sprayed them with bullets.
sentences.zh: 拉里将注意力转向他们，并向他们喷射子弹。

sentences.en: By this point, Larry had been firing at the police for around three minutes.
sentences.zh: 此时，拉里已经向警方开火了大约三分钟。

sentences.en: During that time, he had fired approximately 300 rounds and wounded several officers and civilians.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他发射了大约300发子弹，打伤了几名警员和平民。

sentences.en: At 9.27am, Larry walked back inside the bank

sentences.en: The police struggled to explain the onslaught

sentences.en: One officer put it best when he said I was in the wrong place with the wrong gun
sentences.zh: 一名警员说得最好：“我带着错误的枪出现在了错误的地方。”

sentences.en: The bullets the police were using were incapable of penetrating Larry's body armour and given that most of his body was protected, the police basically had no chance
sentences.zh: 警方使用的子弹无法穿透拉里的防弹衣，考虑到他全身大部分都被保护着，警方基本上毫无胜算。

sentences.en: Larry, on the other hand, had an automatic assault rifle with armour-piercing rounds that were going through cars and walls with ease It wasn't a fair fight
sentences.zh: 另一方面，拉里拥有自动突击步枪，配备的穿甲弹能轻易穿透汽车和墙壁。这根本不是一场公平的战斗。

sentences.en: The dentist on site, Dr Jorge Montes, tended to him right away, but he really needed a hospital
sentences.zh: 现场的牙医豪尔赫·蒙特斯医生立即为他处理伤口，但他确实需要去医院。

sentences.zh: 在外面，越来越多的警员赶到现场，并在周边地区占据了位置。

sentences.zh: 上午9点30分，拉里再次走出银行。

sentences.en: Haynes managed to reach a nearby tree line and took cover, but he was wounded again, this time in the left shin.

sentences.en: Whitfield also tried to take cover behind a nearby tree, but not before being shot through the thigh.
